clang_safety_scope: Eight groups: lifecycle, directory/dup/timers, anonymous/pipe races and file races, each icount0 and realtime. Both race groups contain 41 scenarios including 17 deliberately unsafe controls.
limitations: Two samples per variant/cohort; one small repeated GCC input; host frequency and unrelated activity not controlled.
Clang uses 2bc6e19ae9 including required lexical cleanup-guard scope fix; GCC variants use 80eaf2c89b.
Realtime omits icount and changes clock mode; it is an explicit functional-test option, not deterministic instruction measurement.
Host emulator throughput only; no ISA/RTL or hardware performance claim. Full application qualification is separate.
